final: {"prompt": "A square abstract painting that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, with no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting. It is purely nonrepresentational, with no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. The subject is the tension between pressure and restraint, a mind holding a hard line while many voices pull at it. The palette is a deep oxblood and burnt umber ground, thinly scumbled so darker underlayers glow through. Over it run slabs of cold ultramarine and slate gray, and a few sharp cuts of acid chartreuse and bone white. A dense, congested cluster of short, urgent, overlapping palette-knife strokes in hot vermilion and ochre crowds the upper left. Their rhythm is fast and stuttering, and their edges are ragged and impatient. Against this, one long, unhurried vertical sweep of heavy, cool, unbroken blue-gray pigment drags through the center-right with a loaded wide brush. It is thick, slow, and certain, and it holds its edge while the agitated marks break against it. Thin, scratched, sgraffito lines cut through wet paint to expose pale underlayers. They flicker like second thoughts, some abandoned halfway. Translucent glazes of dusty violet and green-black pool in the lower third, quieter and denser, with a matte, chalky surface that contrasts with glossy, buttery impasto ridges elsewhere. A large area of near-empty, softly mottled off-white and pale gray at the lower right gives breath and uneasy stillness, and the crowded marks lean toward it without quite entering. Layering is visible, with paint scraped back, overpainted, and scraped again. The composition has strong diagonal tension, asymmetrical balance, and sharp value contrast between luminous accents and heavy shadow. The mood is concentrated, wary, and stubbornly clear. It is expressive gestural abstraction with rich oil-paint texture, visible bristle marks, drips, and dry-brush drag, lit evenly like a flat, high-resolution scan of the canvas."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
